articles.title_en: How Much Should We Trust Estimates of Firm Effects and Worker Sorting?
articles.title_cn: 我们应该在多大程度上信任企业效应和工人分类的估计？
articles.abstract_en: Many studies use matched employer-employee data to estimate a statistical model of earnings determination with worker and firm fixed effects. Estimates based on this model have produced influential yet controversial conclusions. The objective of this paper is to assess the sensitivity of these conclusions to the biases that arise because of limited mobility of workers across firms. We use employer-employee data from the United States and several European countries while taking advantage of both fixed effects and random effects methods for bias correction. We find that limited mobility bias is severe and that bias correction is important.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多研究使用匹配的雇主-雇员数据来估计带有工人和企业固定效应的工资决定统计模型。基于该模型的估计产生了有影响力但仍有争议的结论。本文的目标是评估这些结论对因工人在企业间有限流动而产生的偏差的敏感性。我们使用来自美国和几个欧洲国家的雇主-雇员数据，同时利用固定效应和随机效应方法进行偏差校正。我们发现有限流动偏差很严重，且偏差校正很重要。

articles.title_en: Network Connections and Board Seats: Are Female Networks Less Valuable?
articles.title_cn: 网络关系与董事会席位：女性网络价值更低吗？
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how sizes of professional networks affect the probability of appointment to a supervisory board and whether the effect is gendered. Using an employer-employee data set of the Danish labor market, 1995–2011, we find larger networks to associate with a higher probability of becoming a first-time director. The effect is larger for men. One explanation is that men, compared with women, have more connections to larger and listed firms and to other males—attributes that increase the appointment probability. Women who have connections to incumbent directors before being appointed director have more labor market experience than other directors.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究职业网络规模如何影响被任命为监事会成员的概率，以及这一效应是否存在性别差异。使用丹麦劳动力市场的雇主-雇员数据集，1995-2011，我们发现更大的网络与成为首次董事的概率更高相关。这一效应对男性更大。一种解释是，与女性相比，男性拥有更多与更大和上市公司的联系以及与其他男性的联系——这些属性会提高任命概率。在被任命为董事之前与现任董事有联系的女性，比其他董事拥有更多的劳动力市场经验。

articles.title_en: Labor Market Discrimination against Family Responsibilities: A Correspondence Study with Policy Change in China
articles.title_cn: 针对家庭责任的劳动力市场歧视：中国政策变迁的一项通信研究
articles.abstract_en: China shifted its controversial one-child policy (1979–2015) to a two-child policy in 2016. We take advantage of this unexpected policy change and the heterogeneities in the prechange environment to investigate labor market discrimination against expected family responsibilities. In a two-wave correspondence study before and after the policy change, we sent 8,848 fictitious resumes with ages 22–29 in response to online job advertisements. Their gender and only-child/siblinged status were systematically varied. We find that women—but not men—are subject to labor market discrimination for expected family responsibilities. This discrimination worsens with the increase in women’s reproductive age.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国将其有争议的独生子女政策（1979-2015）转变为二孩政策（2016）。我们利用这一意外的政策变化以及变化前环境中的异质性，来研究针对预期家庭责任的劳动力市场歧视。在一项政策变化前后的两轮通信研究中，我们发送了8,848份年龄为22-29的虚构简历，以回应在线招聘广告。其性别和独生子女/有兄弟姐妹身份被系统地变化。我们发现，女性——而非男性——因预期家庭责任而受到劳动力市场歧视。这种歧视随着女性生育年龄的增加而加剧。

articles.title_en: Mothers Working during Preschool Years and Child Skills: Does Income Compensate?
articles.title_cn: 母亲在学龄前阶段工作与儿童技能：收入能否补偿？
articles.abstract_en: Increasing mother’s labor supply during a child’s preschool years may reduce time investments, yielding a negative direct effect on midchildhood and teenage outcomes. But as mother’s work hours increase, income will rise. Can income compensate for the negative effect of hours? Our mediation analysis exploits exogenous variation in both mother’s hours and family income. Results suggest a negative, insignificant direct effect from increasing mother’s hours on child test scores. However, the positive mediating effect of income creates a positive total effect on test scores (26% of a standard deviation) for a 10-hour increase in mother’s weekly hours in preschool years.
articles.abstract_cn: 在儿童学龄前阶段增加母亲的劳动供给可能减少时间投入，从而对儿童中期和青少年期的结果产生负向直接效应。但随着母亲工作小时数增加，收入也会上升。收入能否补偿小时数的负向效应？我们的中介分析利用了母亲小时数和家庭收入两方面的外生变异。结果表明，增加母亲小时数对儿童测验成绩的直接效应为负但不显著。然而，收入的正面中介效应使测验成绩产生正向总效应（26%个标准差），对应学龄前阶段母亲每周小时数增加10小时。

articles.title_en: When the Stadium Goes Silent: How Crowds Affect the Performance of Discriminated Groups
articles.title_cn: 当体育场陷入寂静：观众如何影响受歧视群体的表现
articles.abstract_en: Using a natural experiment induced by COVID-19, we test how the sudden absence of fans at football games impacts player performance in Italy. We find that African players, who are most commonly targeted by racial harassment, play better when fans are no longer at the stadium. A similar, albeit weaker, effect is detected among black players. Using official records of racist behavior by fans, we show that performance improves the most on teams that were subject to abuse before the lockdown. Our evidence suggests that racist pressure can harm discriminated groups and lower the overall quality of the game.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用由COVID-19引发的自然实验，我们检验了足球比赛中球迷突然缺席如何影响意大利球员的表现。我们发现，最常成为种族骚扰目标的非洲球员在球迷不再出现在体育场时表现更好。在黑人球员中也检测到类似但较弱的效应。利用球迷种族主义行为的官方记录，我们表明，在封锁前遭受辱骂的球队中，表现提升最大。我们的证据表明，种族主义压力可能伤害受歧视群体并降低比赛的整体质量。

articles.title_cn: 工作场所激励与组织学习
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies learning among coworkers when incentives change. We use a simple principal-agent model to show that when workers are not fully informed on the global shape of the production function, (1) their effort choice changes over time as information is disclosed and processed and (2) changing incentives can trigger this learning process. We test this prediction using personnel data from an egg production plant in Peru. Exploiting a sudden change in the contract parameters, we find that workers learn from each other over the shape of the production function. This adjustment process is costly for the firm.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究当激励发生变化时同事之间的学习。我们使用一个简单的委托-代理模型来表明，当工人并未完全了解生产函数的全局形态时，（1）他们的努力选择会随着信息的披露和处理而随时间变化，并且（2）激励的变化可以触发这一学习过程。我们使用秘鲁一家鸡蛋生产厂的人事数据来检验这一预测。利用合同参数的突然变化，我们发现工人会相互学习生产函数的形态。这一调整过程对企业而言代价高昂。

articles.title_en: Optimal Allocation of Seats in the Presence of Peer Effects: Evidence from a Job Training Program
articles.title_cn: 存在同伴效应时的最优席位分配：来自一项职业培训项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: We model optimal treatment assignment in programs with a limited number of seats and study how the presence of peer effects impacts the optimal allocation rule. We then use data from a randomized control trial to show evidence that there are large peer effects in the context of job training for disadvantaged adults in the United States. Finally, we combine the model and the empirics to show that the program would have had a much greater impact if the assignment choices had accounted for the peer effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为席位数量有限的项目中的最优处理分配建模，并研究同伴效应的存在如何影响最优分配规则。随后，我们使用一项随机对照试验的数据来表明，在美国弱势成年人的职业培训背景下存在较大的同伴效应。最后，我们将模型与实证结果相结合，表明如果分配选择考虑了同伴效应，该项目的效果本会大得多。

articles.title_en: Foreign Students in College and the Supply of STEM Graduates
articles.title_cn: 大学中的外国学生与STEM毕业生的供给
articles.abstract_en: Do foreign students affect the likelihood that domestic students obtain a STEM degree and occupation? Using administrative student records from a US university, we exploit idiosyncratic variation in the share of foreign classmates in introductory math classes and find that foreign classmates displace domestic students from STEM majors and occupations. However, displaced students gravitate toward high-earning social science majors, so their expected earnings are not penalized. We explore several mechanisms. Results indicate that displacement is concentrated in classes where foreign classmates possess weak English language ability, suggesting that diminished in-class communication and social interactions might play an important role.
articles.abstract_cn: 外国学生是否会影响本国学生获得STEM学位和从事STEM职业的可能性？利用一所美国大学的行政学生记录，我们利用数学入门课程中外国同学比例的异质性变异，发现外国同学会将本国学生从STEM专业和职业中挤出。然而，被挤出的学生会转向高收入的社科专业，因此他们的预期收入并未受到惩罚。我们探讨了几种机制。结果表明，挤出效应集中在外国同学英语语言能力较弱的班级，这表明课堂内交流和社会互动的减少可能发挥了重要作用。
